programs.title: Richard Hammond's Big!: Super Galaxy Plane
programs.desc: Richard Hammond climbs aboard the US Air Force's biggest cargo plane, an airborne behemoth that uses cutting-edge engineering and the latest technology to fly vital equipment and heavy-duty military vehicles across the planet.

programs.title: Dirty Mudder Truckers: The Dirty 7 vs. New England
programs.desc: The Dirty 7, a mega-truck racing crew from Central Florida, challenges teams from all over the country to find the fastest crew  they race team New England in the Pit, a track of mud designed to put the trucks to the test for pride and money.

programs.title: America's Worst Tattoos: He Spelled My Kids' Names Wrong!
programs.desc: Tackling the misplaced anger of a client  a client requests a biomechanical panel.

programs.title: Deadliest Catch: Winter's Curse
programs.desc: A tidal surge threatens Josh and Monte as they chase their bounty deep into an arctic storm  Wild Bill hopes to get his broken boat off the dock  the rest of the fleet arrives for the start of Opilio.

programs.title: Dino Hunters: Curse of the Carnivore
programs.desc: Clayton Phipps and his team prepare to flip a 20,000-pound carnivore fossil out of the earth and onto a flatbed to get it to the lab for analysis  Mike Harris hunts for a duckbill skull  Jared Hudson uncovers an ancient reptile.

programs.title: Bering Sea Gold: Sweet Child O'Mining
programs.desc: Shawn gets his first taste of the shifting seabed  Ken tries a new perspective to find new ground  Kris and Emily each try out greenhorn divers to boost their productivity, but the plan grinds to a halt for one of them.

programs.desc: India's Citizen squad trains MARCOS style in freezing waters of Kashmir.
